name: dev-team
description: A multi-agent development team for Claude Code: an orchestrator skill that plans, builds, reviews, tests and debugs through specialist subagents, with parallel fan-out through workflows, a token profile you choose, and work tracked in TASKS.md.

profile.title: Token profile
profile.description: How much model capability and reasoning effort the team spends. economy routes mechanical work to Sonnet at low effort and keeps verification to one vote; balanced inherits the session model with effort set per role; quality runs every role at the session model and maximum effort with a planning panel and a three-vote review.

fanout.title: Team size
fanout.description: How many agents the orchestrator runs at once. small keeps to two parallel agents and two review lenses; standard allows four and four; large allows eight parallel agents and six review lenses. Workflows are also capped by the Dynamic workflow size setting in /config.

tracker.title: Maintain TASKS.md
tracker.description: Keep a TASKS.md ledger at the project root, updated by the plugin's tasks.py script at every state change. Turn off for throwaway work.
